metadata.title: Restriction Digest Protocol
metadata.purpose: Digest DNA using the three numbered steps and conditional post-digest guidance in the linked NEB restriction-digest protocol.
metadata.scope: NEB 50 µL typical reaction. Individual enzyme temperature and time are deliberately not selected by the source.

materials.name: Restriction enzyme
materials.specification: 5–10 units per µg DNA recommended; add last

materials.name: EDTA-containing stop solution or loading dye

steps.action: Set up the 50 µL reaction on ice according to table t1, adding the restriction enzyme last.
Gently mix the reaction by pipetting up and down and microfuge briefly.
Incubate at the temperature and for the time recommended for the selected restriction endonuclease.
steps.criticalNotes: The linked universal protocol states that enzyme-specific temperatures and times vary significantly.

steps.action: Stop the reaction if no further DNA manipulation is required by adding EDTA-containing stop solution or loading dye.
If further DNA manipulation is required, remove enzyme by an appropriate listed method: compatible heat inactivation, phenol/chloroform extraction, or spin-column purification.

parameters.rawText: 20 min when heat inactivation is appropriate.

limitations: No particular restriction enzyme was identified in the linked source, so incubation conditions and heat-inactivation compatibility remain unresolved.
